card.name: Words before a building or room name
card.fires_on: Words just before a place or room is named, such as a building, hall, office or room number. Seen in office listings, class schedules and descriptions of where something is housed.

modes.label: Where a collection is kept
modes.description: Linking words before a location that holds a museum or library collection.
modes.example: The Woodson Collection is located<< in>> the History/Travel/Biography Division

card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name a room or building where something is located.
